ai.overview: The College Basketball Belt returns to the line as Michigan, fresh off their championship run last season, hosts UConn on a neutral floor. The Wolverines captured the belt during their playoff march and have successfully defended it 2 times in this reign, most recently with an 84–68 victory over Oakland. UConn, a program that has held the belt 15 times before, gets an immediate rematch after falling 63–69 to Michigan in last season's playoffs.

ai.prediction_writeup: Michigan's recent form is undeniable, winners of their last 5 games including a playoff victory over this same UConn squad by a 69–63 margin. The Wolverines demonstrated their dominance throughout last season's playoff run with commanding wins like 95–62 over Tennessee and 91–73 at Arizona. While UConn boasts 15 previous belt reigns and will be hungry for revenge, Michigan has already defended the belt 2 times in this reign and the Elo model backs them as favorites.
